rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something whose own properties or claims contradict each other.

example.english: They say they do not believe in ghosts, but they are too scared to sleep at night—it is truly paradoxical.
example.traditional: 佢話自己唔信鬼，但半夜又驚到唔敢瞓，真係自相矛盾。
